zh.title: 洛克希德馬丁人工智慧操控X-62完成27次實體目標攔截
zh.summary: 洛克希德馬丁於2026年8月4日宣布，一款人工智慧代理操控重度改裝的X-62 VISTA測試機，在加州愛德華空軍基地執行的8個架次測試中，利用實體感測器資料對T-38目標機成功完成27次戰術攔截姿態操作。
body: 洛克希德馬丁於2026年8月4日宣布，一款人工智慧代理操控重度改裝的F-16測試機，利用實體感測器資料對真實目標成功執行27次攔截姿態操作。
這項包含8個架次的測試任務在加利福尼亞州愛德華空軍基地進行，由洛克希德馬丁臭鼬工廠、美國空軍測試飛行員學校及產業夥伴共同執行。
代號VISTA的X-62可變飛行模擬測試機搭載洛克希德馬丁Legion Pod，追蹤作為目標的T-38噴射機，並將目標資料傳送至機載人工智慧代理，由其操控飛機進入戰術攔截位置。
洛克希德馬丁表示，其Supermassive代理生成能力使團隊能在三個月內完成人工智慧代理與X-62測試機的全面整合與地面測試。該X-62機型為具備Block 40航電系統的改裝F-16D Block 30，由美國空軍測試飛行員學校營運。

en.title: Lockheed Martin AI Agent Executes 27 Target Intercepts Aboard X-62 VISTA
en.summary: Lockheed Martin announced on August 4, 2026, that an artificial intelligence agent successfully executed 27 live-target intercepts aboard the X-62 VISTA experimental aircraft during an eight-sortie campaign at Edwards Air Force Base in California. The aircraft used real-time sensor data from a Lockheed Martin Legion Pod tracking a T-38 target plane, allowing the onboard AI agent to maneuver the modified F-16 into tactical intercept positions. Ground integration and testing were completed within three months using the company's Supermassive capability.
body: Lockheed Martin announced on August 4, 2026, that an artificial intelligence agent flew a heavily modified F-16 into 27 intercepts against a live target using operational sensor data.
The eight-sortie campaign was conducted at Edwards Air Force Base in California by Lockheed Martin Skunk Works, the US Air Force Test Pilot School, and industry partners.

The X-62 Variable In-flight Simulation Test Aircraft (VISTA) carried a Lockheed Martin Legion Pod that tracked a T-38 target plane. The pod passed data to an onboard AI agent, which maneuvered the jet into a tactical intercept position.

Lockheed Martin said its Supermassive capability allowed full integration and ground testing of the agents with the X-62 within three months. The X-62 is a modified F-16D Block 30 with Block 40 avionics operated by the US Air Force Test Pilot School.
